content: {"reasoning":"The prior CO-22 conflicts with the verified correct COB order, and a corrected claim has already been resubmitted with no new payer response. Another submission risks unnecessary duplication, while patient or secondary billing is premature before the primary payer resolves its COB issue; no appeal, retro-authorization, or peer-to-peer path is currently available. A specialist must investigate the payer’s COB records and claim status.","action":"escalate"}
